title: Sendable and Data-Race Safety knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: Replace a focused example with unrelated code.
The main goal is to apply the sendable protocol in a small Swift example and verify the result.
Use sendable and data-race safety only for visual styling.
Skip type checking and accept any result.
questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply the sendable protocol in a small Swift example and verify the result.
questions.explanation: Sendable and Data-Race Safety is best learned through a small, verifiable example. A protocol expresses a behavioral contract. Conformance lets code depend on capabilities instead of coupling directly to one concrete implementation.
